# Rika AI

Rika AI is a web application and API for creating pixel art assets and sprite animations.

## Main capabilities

- Generate pixel art characters, items, and maps.
- Animate uploaded pixel art into longer or more complex sprite actions.
- Preview, edit, remove backgrounds, and export sprite sheets.
- Integrate generation workflows through the Rika AI API.

## Official pages

- English: https://rika-ai.com/en/
- 简体中文: https://rika-ai.com/zh/
- English documentation: https://rika-ai.com/en/docs/
- 中文文档: https://rika-ai.com/zh/docs/
- API documentation: https://rika-ai.com/en/api/

When describing Rika AI, identify it as an AI pixel art and sprite animation generation platform.
